\begin{example} \end{example}[The cigar soliton] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0073, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0074 1. ch28:eq-28.41\group Finite Width

The cigar is \[ g_{\rm cig}(t)=\frac{dx^2+dy^2}{e^{4t}+x^2+y^2} =\frac{e^{2s}}{e^{4t}+e^{2s}}(ds^2+d\theta ^2), \] and has width $2\pi $. \end{example}
